chunks: Then, one of the Khawarij said: May Allah kill him, a heretic, how logical he is!
The people then leapt towards him to kill him, but he (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.أَفْقَهَهُ: How logical/intelligent he is (literally: how much he understands)
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: Khawarij (a sect known for their extremism and early rebellion)
key_terms.قَاتَلَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah kill him (an idiom of strong disapproval or curse)

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) handle the Khawarij's insult?
ai.summary: This incident highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) characteristic forbearance when confronted by the Khawarij, a sect known for its literalism and impulsiveness, illustrating the virtue of *hilm* (forbearance) over immediate retaliation. It serves as a practical model for maintaining composure and spiritual dignity even when one's intellect or status is mocked by those prone to hasty judgment.
